topic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
source_evidence: Margin Interest - the interest that a broker-dealer may charge you for loans from your margin account.
answer: Margin interest is the interest a broker-dealer may charge when you borrow money through a margin account. When opening a brokerage account, check whether you are choosing a margin account and make sure you understand the fees that may apply, including margin interest. A cash account does not allow you to borrow from the brokerage firm to pay for transactions.
